text: eganyé. Your tontine, on your phone.
Lost notebooks. Who paid? Who’s missing?
Your circles, your money. All in one place.
Start your circle. Invite your people, by link or by code.
Pay in with Flooz or Mixx. Every franc is visible, and the pot fills up.
At the heart of eganyé, there’s AI. It estimates your reliability, and explains your score.
It warns you before you’re late.
It estimates the risk for each round, without naming anyone.
And it never decides for you.
When it’s your turn, the pot lands in your wallet.
Put money aside in your vaults. Withdraw with your PIN.
